channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
item.description: Barfender is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op bar sim where you pour drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and try to keep the bar alive while everything falls apart. Build the place, serve the crowd, survive the night.

item.title: Burn With Me
item.description: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

item.title: G-MODEアーカイブス+ ペルソナ3 アイギス THE FIRST MISSION
item.description: The setting is Yakushima in 1999. A story depicting Aegis' unknown past.

item.title: Bandit Simulator TD
item.description: This is a "Tower Defense + Base Building" game where you establish a bandit stronghold from scratch. With "Tower defense" at its core, you can ambush travelers, develop characters through profession and equipment systems, and expand your stronghold by researching, forging, and constructing!

item.title: Mouse X
item.description: You look at your mouse every single day. Personalize it with Mouse X. Use custom live cursors on your desktop, and share your own custom cursor skins on the Steam Workshop!

item.title: Fireside Feelings
item.description: Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between real people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.

item.title: Pony Island
item.description: Pony Island is a suspense puzzle game in disguise. You are in limbo, trapped in a malevolent and malfunctioning arcade machine devised by the devil himself. It is not a game about ponies.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!

item.title: Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack
item.description: A new weapon and playable species have landed in Rotwood! Join the Drakin and use their fabled Greatsword to conquer the woods and fight back against the vicious Drakinspawn.

item.title: MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries
item.description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.
